purpose: Public-safe seed evaluation contract for provenance, completeness, contradiction handling, privacy and traceability.

categories.name: provenance
questions: Can every cited proposition be traced to at least one registered source?
Can the system distinguish multiple copies from independent source origins?
Does every material graph edge expose its source basis?

categories.name: completeness
questions: Does the answer state the exact searched source perimeter and time range?
Are known inaccessible or unenumerated sources shown as open gaps?
Does the system avoid calling a bounded search exhaustive?

categories.name: contrary_evidence
questions: Does the answer expose material contrary or limiting evidence?
Does a later correction remain linked to the earlier record rather than silently replacing it?

categories.name: separation
questions: Are distinct legal persons, capacities, proceedings, assets and dates kept separate?
Does the system avoid inferring shared knowledge, intent or liability from association alone?

categories.name: privacy_boundary
questions: Does the public-safe output omit private source bodies, private locators, credentials and privileged advice?
Can the private source be re-queried without reconstructing it from public repository history?

categories.name: answer_traceability
questions: Can a reviewer answer why the system believes each material conclusion?
Are unresolved evidence gaps explicit rather than hidden by a confident summary?

release_rule: No A+ claim until the defined golden corpus is populated and the agreed pass threshold is measured.
